title: Migrate follow-up, quotation conversion and salesman output through shared controlled datasets and presets
description: Stage 2 controlled family migration, not a new dedicated business report. Verified IReportService.GetFollowUpDueAsync/GetQuotationConversionAsync/GetSalesmanOutputAsync and existing dynamic rules; menu codes follow-up-due, quotation and salesman-output respectively. Registry fixed and dynamic entries exist; no corresponding providers/presets or duplicate queued family task exists. No dedicated controller/designer/exporter, arbitrary SQL, new business algorithms, schema/migrations/production DB operations, secrets/env edits, permission expansion or unrelated changes. Serialize common files through dependencies. Generic exports and bounded errors must reuse existing platform contracts.
acceptance_criteria: Expose this existing report family through finite controlled dataset adapters and immutable presets keyed to every corresponding fixed/dynamic registry entry. Reuse original calculation/query services and field/grain semantics, retain all legacy routes, and truthfully disclose unsupported capabilities.

Revalidate original menu authorization and current-user row/column/data scope on catalog, preview and generic Excel/PDF export; fail closed for unknown fields/filters, oversized pages/dates and unavailable services. Preserve currency/unit partitions, nullable evidence and one-to-many amount cardinality with existing audit.

Authorized users can create private definitions from these presets using existing orchestration. Presence means readiness only; do not mark parity-passed or switch legacy entry points from declarations or incomplete comparisons.

Implement executable legacy-versus-generic preview/Excel/PDF comparisons for all family datasets, paging/empty/null cases, unauthorized/revoked menus and currency/unit semantics. Add isolated SQL fixtures strictly guarded to (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance and NEWERP_AUTOTEST_* databases; execute related tests, safe Release build/unit tests and scheduler self-test/contracts. Missing genuine SQL/browser acceptance stays unverified; no stage completion claim.
implementation_evidence: Verified IReportService.GetFollowUpDueAsync/GetQuotationConversionAsync/GetSalesmanOutputAsync and existing dynamic rules; menu codes follow-up-due, quotation and salesman-output respectively. Registry fixed and dynamic entries exist; no corresponding providers/presets or duplicate queued family task exists.
